changelog:
my-coffee v0.8.4

- Expanded keywords and description to recognize more user intents and beverage/product phrases (added terms like 拿铁、美式、生椰拿铁、橙C美式、点一杯等).
- Modified documentation for price fields: now references “价格” instead of “原价” in order preview and order creation, to better align with actual returned data fields.
- Removed outdated or redundant documentation files (skill-card.md).
- Minor clarifications and alignment of instructions in SKILL.md; version updated to 0.8.4.
summary: Use when users ask to order Luckin Coffee, search Luckin stores/products, query pickup code/order status, cancel a Luckin order, or mention 瑞幸、luckin、咖啡、拿铁、美...
